summary: On Friday, October 16, the Choice cutout was $372.31 per hundredweight, down $1.67 from the day before, and Select was $353.05, up $0.43. Choice ran $19.26 over Select. Packers sold 103 loads of Choice cuts and 5 of Select on negotiated deals that day, plus 15 of trimmings and 11 of coarse ground beef.
